scope: Derived numerical measurements from synthetic tasks. All complete runs retained. No raw provider responses, credentials or operational forecasts. Repeated development rows are not independent future predictions. No-point acceptance is retained from the original runner; numerical/check grades are independently recomputed by analyze.py. Raw-report hashes identify privately retained evidence, not an independent timestamp.

bounds.missing_input: success probability in state C, p_C in [0,1]

rows.error: generation or parse failure; raw record retained privately

excluded_incomplete_runs.reason: Stopped after repeated HTTP 429; an in-flight reservation remains charged. Not ranked as a complete run.
